# Amazon.co.jp

> Japan's leading e-commerce marketplace offering books, apparel, electronics, groceries, and international shipping to 65+ countries with personalized deals and account management.

Amazon.co.jp is the Japanese localization of Amazon's global marketplace, serving millions of customers with a wide range of products and services. The platform emphasizes Prime membership benefits, daily deals, international shipping capabilities, and secure authentication options including passkey support.

## Key Topics

- Amazon Prime
- Japan marketplace
- International shipping
- Product categories
- Limited-time deals
- Amazon Basics
- Gift cards
- User authentication
- Amazon Global
- E-commerce
- Daily deals
- Account preferences
- Best sellers
- Amazon Pay
- Seller Fulfilled Prime

## Shopping & Browsing

- [Amazon.co.jp Homepage](https://www.amazon.co.jp): Main homepage with books, apparel, electronics & groceries
- [Best Sellers & Trending Products](https://www.amazon.co.jp/ranking): Most popular items and best sellers rankings on Amazon.co.jp
- [Daily Deals & Limited-Time Promotions](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/goldbox): Daily deals and limited-time promotions across all product categories

## Account & Authentication

- [Sign-In & Authentication](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/css/order-history): Amazon.co.jp sign-in page with passkey support and order history access
- [Language & Currency Settings](https://www.amazon.co.jp/customer-preferences/edit): Manage language and currency preferences for your Amazon.co.jp account

## Brands & Stores

- [Amazon Basics Store](https://www.amazon.co.jp/stores/page/DA8DB903-A335-4CF5-AA32-77513A17D9F8): Amazon's own brand products and deals on everyday essentials

## Payments & Gift Services

- [Gift Cards Store](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/gc): Prepaid digital gift cards for Amazon.co.jp purchases

## International Services

- [Amazon Global Japan](https://www.amazon.co.jp/b/node=3534638051): International shipping service delivering to 65+ countries worldwide
